title: Norwood Financial Corp Adopts Stock Repurchase Program
summary: HONESDALE, Pa., Aug. 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Norwood Financial Corp (the “Company”) (Nasdaq Global Market-NWFL), the holding company of Wayne Bank, today announced that its Board of Directors has adopted a stock repurchase program. Under the repurchase program, the Company may repurchase up to 550,000 shares of its common stock, representing approximately 5% of the Company’s issued and outstanding shares.
